name: dom-framework-benchmark
description: The same to-do app in React, Angular, Vue and Svelte, and a benchmark of their DOM operations.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix apps/react install && npm --prefix apps/vue install && npm --prefix apps/svelte install && npm --prefix apps/angular install
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/react run build && npm --prefix apps/vue run build && npm --prefix apps/svelte run build && npm --prefix apps/angular run build
